> Immaculate Spaces is a women-owned, LGBTQ+ friendly house cleaning service based in Dallas, TX, available 24 hours a day. Known for exceptional thoroughness, strong communication, and a customer-first approach, the business is led by Shelly and has earned a perfect 5-star reputation. The brand stands out for its ability to accommodate last-minute bookings, its attention to detail, and its warm, reassuring client experience — making it a trusted choice for both routine and deep cleaning needs.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Immaculate Spaces
Immaculate Spaces is a women-owned, LGBTQ+ friendly house cleaning service based in Dallas, TX, available 24 hours a day. Known for exceptional thoroughness, strong communication, and a customer-first approach, the business is led by Shelly and has earned a perfect 5-star reputation. The brand stands out for its ability to accommodate last-minute bookings, its attention to detail, and its warm, reassuring client experience — making it a trusted choice for both routine and deep cleaning needs.

## Services/Products
- House cleaning
- Deep cleaning
- Carpet cleaning
- Next-day/last-minute cleaning

## Target Audience
- Homeowners and residents in the Dallas area looking for reliable, thorough cleaning services
- Dallas Homeowners
- Busy Professionals
- New Parents
